title.narrative: Strengthening Institutional Capacity for One Health Strategic Planning and Economic Analysis

description.narrative: The Government of Turkey has requested Bank assistance to develop a national animal health plan together with an economic analysis of the cost of zoonotic and other animal diseases. An IDF grant in the amount of $462comma500 is requested to provide technical assistance and expertise to assist in the preparation of the plan and the economic assessment. This work would be carried out concurrently with a substantial programmatic technical assistance initiative related to food safety. The IDF grant would be complementary to the food safety TAcomma and the respective results will be harmonized to provide a comprehensive review and operational guidelines to address animal health and related public health and food safety risks in Turkey. TF098646 The Development Objective of Grant is to build Government capacity through the application of analytical tools and processes that provide guidance for the improvement of planning and decision-making related to animal health services and public health systems. The specific areas of focus will include: (i) formulation of a strategic plan for upgrading the veterinary services to meet EU pre-accession requirements through close collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (MARA)comma (ii) identification of key technicalcomma knowledge and institutional gaps in the public health system and prepare a strategic plan for reform related to zoonotic diseases jointly with the Ministry of Health (MOH)comma (iii) provision of capacity building to produce an economic analysis of the impact of zoonotic diseases on peoplecomma trade and the national economy and to provide for advocacy and risk communication. This will enable decision-makers to more effectively formulate policy reforms and identify targeted investments.
